settings.heading: Complete your ritual
settings.text: Each step makes the next one work harder. Here's what pairs with this one.

settings.question: How do I use this with the rest of the ritual?
settings.answer: Toner first on clean skin, then serum, then lotion to seal. Frank Castor is a weekly treatment. Use it on skin or hair, or as the final step at night.

settings.question: Is it safe for sensitive skin?
settings.answer: Yes. Formulated without parabens or harsh chemicals. Patch test on your inner arm for 24 hours before first use, as you would with any new product.

settings.question: When will I see a difference?
settings.answer: Hydration is immediate. Tone and texture changes usually show at the three to four week mark with consistent twice-daily use.
